about_short_description.short_description: UNLOCK is transforming the way companies buy and sell services.

product.name: UNLOCK B2B Procurement Marketplace
product.description: An AI-powered platform that matches companies with professional service providers based on their service needs, enabling faster procurement and selection of proposals.

product.name: Service Partner Program
product.description: A program that enables professional service agencies to join UNLOCK, access qualified business opportunities, and manage client proposals and payments through the platform.

product.name: UNLOCKGPT AI Assistant
product.description: An AI assistant that helps users specify their service needs and facilitates the matching process with suitable service providers.

product.name: Business Expansion Support Services
product.description: Consulting and facilitation services to help companies expand and grow their business in Egypt by connecting them with relevant service providers.

product.name: Professional Services Categories
product.description: A broad range of professional services including IT & digital transformation, marketing & advertising, consulting, accounting, legal, HR, and training services offered through the UNLOCK platform.
